common.welcome: *"Welcome. Before we design your personal 30-minute exercise program, we need to understand your current body. This 10-minute assessment is not a test—it is a safety check. It helps us find the right starting level so you never push too hard or too fast. Answer honestly. If something feels painful or unsafe, stop immediately. Your safety is our #1 priority."*

onboarding.title: Elderly Online Training System
onboarding.note: 📌 Note: For registration, we will save your data. For updates/retrieval, we require **both** your registered email and username to match.

safety_flags.chest_pain: Chest pain or irregular heartbeat at rest
safety_flags.replacement: Hip/knee/spine replacement in the last 6 months
safety_flags.bp_osteo: Uncontrolled high BP (>160/100) or severe osteoporosis
safety_flags.falls: Fallen more than twice in the last month

sarcf_questions.falls: 5. How many falls in the last year?

onboarding.single_leg_help: Stand beside a chair. Lift one foot. Enter the longest time (seconds) you held it.
onboarding.chair_stand_help: Sit on a chair with your arms crossed over your chest, resting on your shoulders. Stand up and sit down as many times as you can in 15 seconds.
onboarding.chair_stand_demo: 💡 Count how many times you can stand up completely in 15 seconds. Use a timer on your phone.
onboarding.no_profile: ❌ No profile found. Please check your email and username, or register as a new user.
onboarding.medical_info: You have reported one or more medical red flags. Please consult your physician before starting any exercise program.
onboarding.medical_expectation: We recommend you share this assessment with your doctor to get personalized clearance.
onboarding.registration_success: Registration successful! Your data has been saved.
onboarding.email_exists: Email already registered. Please use 'Update Profile' or login with a different email.
onboarding.match_error: No matching user found. Please check your email and username.

training.title: 🧓 Daily Training
training.habit_message: 💡 You're building a strong habit. Tomorrow is another step forward!
training.rest_day_options: Today is a rest day. Choose one:
rest_choices: 📖 Read a chapter of the Bible
🧘 Focus on 10 minutes of diaphragmatic breathing

1.name: Supine Glute Bridge
1.desc: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Press heels, lift hips.
1.key_cue: Lower like pressing through honey—4 seconds down.

2.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
2.desc: Lie on side, bottom knee bent, top leg lifted to 45°.

3.name: Standing Hip Abduction (Chair)
3.desc: Stand behind chair, hold backrest, lift leg out to side.
3.key_cue: Lower as slowly as you lifted.

4.name: Seated Calf Raise (Toes Up)
4.desc: Sit upright, feet flat. Lift toes, heels stay down.
4.key_cue: The magic is in the lowering.

5.name: Standing Calf Raise (Chair)
5.desc: Stand holding chair, rise onto balls of feet.

6.name: Loaded Calf Stretch
6.desc: Facing wall, one leg back. Front leg bends, back heel lifts (2s) and lowers (4s).
6.key_cue: Control the heel lift and lower.

7.name: Kegel (Pelvic Floor)
7.desc: Sit or lie down. Squeeze pelvic floor muscles, hold, release slowly.

8.name: Bridge + Pelvic Integration
8.desc: Lie on back, knees bent. Engage pelvic floor, then lift hips.
8.key_cue: Engage pelvic floor BEFORE you lift the hips.

10.name: Seated Resisted Leg Raise
10.desc: Sit tall. Lift one leg while pressing down with hands to resist (2s). Then use hands to push leg down while leg resists (4s).
10.breath_cue: Exhale (lift with resistance, 2s). Inhale (lower with resistance, 4s).
10.key_cue: Push up against your hands. Resist the push down.

11.name: Single-Leg Stand (Chair)
11.desc: Stand holding chair, lift one foot, hold.
11.breath_cue: Exhale (lift, 2s). Breathe steady during hold. Inhale (lower, 4s).
11.key_cue: Place the foot down like it's made of glass.

12.name: Tandem Stand (Heel-to-Toe)
12.desc: Stand with one foot directly in front of the other, heel to toe.
12.breath_cue: Exhale (position, 2s). Breathe steady during hold. Inhale (return, 4s).
12.key_cue: Press your big toe and heel into the floor.

13.name: Static Forward Lunge
13.desc: Step forward, lower back knee toward floor.

14.name: Static Side Lunge
14.desc: Step wide, shift weight to bent knee.

15.name: Modified Downward Dog (Wall)
15.desc: Hands on wall, walk down into a forward bend.
15.key_cue: Press palms firmly. Draw shoulders down.

16.name: Seated Lat Stretch
16.desc: Sit tall, reach overhead, lean to one side.

17.name: Supported Deep Squat Hold
17.desc: Hold counter, lower into deep squat.
17.key_cue: Lower like a feather, rise like a spring.

18.name: Partial Wall Squat
18.desc: Back against wall, slide to 45° knee bend.
18.breath_cue: Exhale (slide down, 4s). Breathe in hold. Inhale (slide up, 2s).
18.key_cue: Wall squats build strength on the way down.

19.name: Seated Trunk Rotation
19.desc: Sit tall, arms crossed, rotate upper body to one side. Hold for 4s, return.
19.key_cue: Hips glued to chair. Only upper body moves.

20.name: Supine Spinal Twist
20.desc: Lie flat, arms stretched out (T-shape). Both knees bent, rotate legs to one side. Hold.
20.breath_cue: Exhale (rotate legs, 4s). Hold (10s, normal breath). Inhale (return, 2s).
20.key_cue: Both shoulder blades stay on the floor.

L0_1.name: Seated Glute Squeeze
L0_1.desc: Sit tall. Squeeze glutes together, hold, release.
L0_1.key_cue: Squeeze like holding a coin between your cheeks.

L0_2.name: Seated Hip Abduction (Band)
L0_2.desc: Sit tall. Push knees outward against band (or towel).
L0_2.key_cue: Push against the band like opening a book.

L0_3.name: Seated Knee Lift
L0_3.desc: Sit tall, hold chair sides. Lift knee toward chest.
L0_3.key_cue: Lift like stepping over a small log.

L0_4.name: Seated Heel Raise
L0_4.desc: Sit tall. Lift heels off floor, rise onto balls of feet.
L0_4.key_cue: Rise up, lower down like a feather.

L0_5.name: Seated Single-Leg Lift
L0_5.desc: Sit tall. Extend one leg forward, foot flexed.
L0_5.key_cue: Point toes up, lower with control.

L0_6.name: Seated Leg Extension
L0_6.desc: Sit tall. Straighten one knee, extend leg forward.

L0_7.name: Seated Squat Reach
L0_7.desc: Sit tall. Lean forward, reach hands toward feet.
L0_7.key_cue: Reach like picking up something from the floor.

L0_8.name: Seated Toe Taps
L0_8.desc: Sit tall. Tap toes alternately on the floor.
